component.name: Horizon
component.summary: Play Minecraft: Java Edition rewritten in Rust

description.p: Horizon is an unofficial rewrite of Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 in Rust. This launcher installs, prepares and plays it. You need a Microsoft account that owns Java Edition.
This is an unofficial Flatpak of the Horizon launcher. Neither Horizon nor this package is approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
